name: TDspPlaits2
description: Authentic Mutable Instruments Plaits macro-oscillator (Emilie Gillet, MIT) exposed as a Teensy Audio Library source. Vendors plaits/ + the stmlib DSP subset (dsp + utils only; no fft/midi/programming/ui). AudioSynthPlaits wraps one Plaits Voice as a mono int16 AudioStream node (renders native 48 kHz in kBlockSize=12 chunks); Plaits2Sink is a MidiSink-driven, MPE-aware polyphonic voice pool over N AudioSynthPlaits nodes. Supersedes the stock-primitive lib/TDspPlaits approximation.
